# `make_dt_interval`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Make DayTimeIntervalType duration from days, hours, mins and secs.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_dt_interval([days[, hours[, mins[, secs]]]])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_dt_interval, example 1
> SELECT make_dt_interval(1, 12, 30, 01.001001);
1 12:30:01.001001000
```

```sql
-- make_dt_interval, example 2
> SELECT make_dt_interval(2);
2 00:00:00.000000000
```

```sql
-- make_dt_interval, example 3
> SELECT make_dt_interval(100, null, 3);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.2.0.
